patterns: No APPSC PYQ here: the questions come from other state PSCs as one-liners. Bahmani founder Alauddin Hasan, first capital Gulbarga, founded in the 14th century.
Other recurring facts: 'Akbar of Kashmir' / first to abolish jizya = Zain-ul-Abidin (original name Shahi Khan); Jaunpur = Shiraz of India, founded by Firoz Tughlaq; last Sharqi ruler Hussain Shah.
UPPSC uses a chronicle match (Mirat-i-Sikandari Gujarat, Burhan-i-Maasir Ahmadnagar, Riyaz-us-Salatin Bengal, Riyaz-ul-Insha Gawan's letters).
For APPSC the angle is Bahmani-Vijayanagara (Raichur Doab), Mahmud Gawan and the Golconda succession.
The app is heavily multi-statement with Mandu/Jaunpur monument detail and Gawan's reforms. That is deeper than the PYQs show, but accurate.
